create_Ion_from_atoms: create an Ion object by passing an ase.Atoms structure directly to the constructor
create_Ion_from_db_index: create an Ion object by selecting a specific ion from the database using its index
create_Ion_random: create an Ion object that randomly selects an ion from the ion database
get_ion_concentration: compute the ion concentration in molar units given a volume in Angstrom cubed
load_ion_from_dict: load ion fields including atoms, name, and charge from a dictionary into the Ion object
